payload.comment: Abstention report is internally consistent. Arithmetic verified: test_coverage (0.405432) + abstain_rate (0.594568) = 1.0; selective_risk (0.005496) = 1 − accuracy_on_covered (0.994504); human_review_count (4269) = 7180 × 0.594568. OOD headline AUROC (0.873799) equals the mean of the three max_softmax test AUROCs (0.903044, 0.888165, 0.830187); validation AUROC (0.988247) equals the mean of the three max_softmax validation AUROCs. Threshold calibrated on validation to hit 0.8 coverage (achieved 0.80008) is applied to test, yielding 0.405432 coverage — a large gap, but the mechanism is behaving conservatively rather than incorrectly (selective risk 0.55%, covered accuracy 99.45%). OOD scope is appropriately labelled 'controlled_corruption_proxy'. No deterministic findings. Cross-artefact a1
